title: M6 External Evidence Check
summary: External launch evidence is still missing; local readiness remains useful but cannot close M6 production launch.

checks.title: WeChat real-device evidence
checks.detail: WECHAT_APP_ID, WECHAT_TEST_ACCOUNT, and real-device evidence manifest are required.

checks.title: Production runtime environment
checks.detail: DATABASE_URL must not be local, PRIVATE_FILE_DIR must be a production storage path/service mount, and PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL must be HTTPS.

checks.title: Object storage/private evidence policy
checks.detail: Need signed retention, access-control, backup, restore, and evidence-download policy for private payment files.

checks.title: Production backup and recovery drill
checks.detail: Need production recovery drill with RPO <= 15 minutes and RTO <= 4 hours, signed by release/ops owner.

checks.title: Customer initialization and finance sign-off
checks.detail: Need customer source files, cutoff date, opening balances, uncleared receivables/payables, role binding review, and finance sign-off.

checks.title: Customer pilot and handover sign-off
checks.detail: Need real pilot stores/suppliers, pilot window, recharge/clearing, statement/payment cycle, issue closure, and handover sign-off.
